# project
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "/usr/lib64/ccache/clang")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "/usr/lib64/ccache/clang++")
set(CMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES ON)
project(celine_tests LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID})
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
if(NOT CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    if(MSVC)
        set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT "MSVC")
    else()
        set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT "GNU")
    endif()
endif()
if(DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    set(CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
endif()
if(NOT CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    set(CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
endif()

# target
add_executable(celine_bin "")
set_target_properties(celine_bin PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "celine_bin")
set_target_properties(celine_bin PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux/x86_64/release")
add_dependencies(celine_bin celine_lib)
target_compile_options(celine_bin PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-m64>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-m64>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-stdlib=libc++>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-stdlib=libc++>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-DNDEBUG>
)
set_target_properties(celine_bin PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(celine_bin PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(celine_bin PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O2>)
else()
    target_compile_options(celine_bin PRIVATE -O3)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
else()
    target_compile_options(celine_bin PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set_property(TARGET celine_bin PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()
target_link_libraries(celine_bin PRIVATE
    celine_lib
)
target_link_directories(celine_bin PRIVATE
    build/linux/x86_64/release
)
target_link_options(celine_bin PRIVATE
    -m64
    -stdlib=libc++
)
# private sourcefiles from sourcebatch c++.build for target celine_bin
target_sources(celine_bin PRIVATE 
    src/main.cpp
)
